title: CDS missing source
defect: Missing CDS source from frozen inventory
sapRequirement: Target release/compiler, real dependencies, activation and relevant SAP runtime tests.

rootCause.explanation: The CDS source is absent. cds_parser_error detects parsing, not a complete CDS dependency contract. The selected LSP emitted no source-resolution finding.
rootCause.scope: Pinned cds_parser_error.run handles DDLS/DDLX parse errors. check_syntax.run applies to ABAPObject, not a full CDS semantic verifier.

note: Track-related closure capabilities are broader than this individual case; no claim of a new case-specific closure verdict.
